appraisal_events.evidence: De ce jour il cessa de me témoigner la même amitié, et, ce qui m'était plus pénible, n'eut plus pour mon caractère la même estime.
appraisal_events.explanation: In the staged scene, the narrator refuses to leave the train to greet Bloch's father (really out of jealous surveillance of Albertine), and Bloch reads this as snobbery; as a direct result Bloch withdraws his friendship and esteem for the narrator's character.

appraisal_events.evidence: La porte s'ouvrit et Mme de Cambremer faillit se trouver mal en voyant Morel entrer seul... désespérant... Mme de Cambremer qui avait dit à M. et Mme Féré que Morel voyait Charlus à toutes les heures du jour.
appraisal_events.explanation: Mme de Cambremer had staged the dinner specifically to display Charlus to the Férés; Morel's solitary arrival and flat announcement that Charlus will not come publicly deflates her carefully engineered social display in front of her guests.

status_effects.explanation: The narrator's standing with a friend is diminished: Bloch, misreading a scene-staged refusal as snobbery, withdraws his esteem and former warmth toward him.
Her planned social coup of introducing Charlus to the Férés collapses in front of her guests when he fails to appear, undercutting the display she had built up.
